_comment: Justifications for ONE-SIDED twin re-pins (renquant-pipeline#232). An entry suppresses the CI finding for exactly one pair moving from one exact digest tuple to one exact digest tuple. It cannot be written in advance, cannot be reused for the next change, and goes STALE the moment either side moves again -- a leftover entry is reported, because it would otherwise silently pre-authorise a future divergence. `reason` must be non-empty: a justification with no justification is a rubber stamp. Required keys per entry: pair, old_public_sha256, old_kernel_sha256, new_public_sha256, new_kernel_sha256, reason.
